on_select.condition: not sceneState.hookHandled and (sceneState.combatState == 'log' or sceneState.combatState == 'victory' or sceneState.combatState == 'levelup')

scripts.announceLevelUp:
local sceneState = ctx.sceneState
if sceneState.combatState ~= "levelup" or sceneState.levelUpIndex == sceneState.announcedLevelUpIndex then return end
sceneState.announcedLevelUpIndex = sceneState.levelUpIndex
sceneState.eventsQueue = sceneState.eventsQueue or {}
sceneState.eventQueueIndex = #sceneState.eventsQueue + 1
table.insert(sceneState.eventsQueue, { type = "text", text = tostring(sceneState.levelUpName or "A creature") .. " has leveled up!" })
sceneState.pendingLevelUpLog = true
sceneState.combatState = "log"
api.battle.advanceLog()
sceneState.hookHandled = true
scripts.handleInput:
local sceneState = ctx.sceneState
local b = sceneState.battle

if sceneState.confirmPhase then
    if sceneState.action == "up" or sceneState.action == "left" or sceneState.action == "down" or sceneState.action == "right" then
        sceneState.selectedIndex = (sceneState.selectedIndex % 2) + 1
    elseif sceneState.action == "cancel" then
        api.battle.undoAction()
    elseif sceneState.action == "select" then
        if sceneState.selectedIndex == 1 then
            api.battle.submitRound()
        else
            api.battle.undoAction()
        end
    end
    return
end

local memberInfo = (sceneState.livingMembers or {})[sceneState.activeMemberIdx or 1]
if not memberInfo then
    sceneState.combatState = "log"
    return
end

if sceneState.inspectingTarget then
    if sceneState.action == "cancel" or sceneState.action == "inspect" then
        sceneState.inspectingTarget = false
    elseif sceneState.action == "up" then
        sceneState.inspectStateIdx = math.max(1, (sceneState.inspectStateIdx or 1) - 1)
    elseif sceneState.action == "down" then
        -- we don't know the exact max here without re-evaluating the target,
        -- but the renderer clamps it so we can just increment.
        sceneState.inspectStateIdx = (sceneState.inspectStateIdx or 1) + 1
    end
    return
end

if sceneState.targetSelect then
    local targeting = api.targeting
    local candidates = targeting.getCandidates(memberInfo.actor, sceneState.pendingAction.targetSpec, b)
    if sceneState.action == "up" or sceneState.action == "left" then
        if #candidates > 0 then sceneState.targetIndex = (sceneState.targetIndex - 2) % #candidates + 1 end
    elseif sceneState.action == "down" or sceneState.action == "right" then
        if #candidates > 0 then sceneState.targetIndex = sceneState.targetIndex % #candidates + 1 end
    elseif sceneState.action == "inspect" then
        sceneState.inspectingTarget = true
    elseif sceneState.action == "cancel" then
        sceneState.targetSelect = false
        sceneState.selectedIndex = sceneState.prevSelectedIndex or 1
    elseif sceneState.action == "select" then
        if #candidates > 0 then
            local chosenTarget = candidates[sceneState.targetIndex]
            sceneState.targetSelect = false
            api.battle.commitAction(memberInfo.index, { type = sceneState.pendingAction.type, id = sceneState.pendingAction.id, itemIndex = sceneState.pendingAction.itemIndex, target = chosenTarget })
        end
    end
    return
end

if sceneState.skillSelect then
    local options = {}
    for _, skId in ipairs(memberInfo.actor.skills or {}) do
        local sk = api.getSkill(skId)
        if sk then table.insert(options, sk) end
    end

    if sceneState.action == "up" then
        if #options > 0 then sceneState.selectedIndex = (sceneState.selectedIndex - 2) % #options + 1 end
    elseif sceneState.action == "down" then
        if #options > 0 then sceneState.selectedIndex = sceneState.selectedIndex % #options + 1 end
    elseif sceneState.action == "cancel" then
        sceneState.skillSelect = false
        sceneState.selectedIndex = sceneState.submenuReturnIndex or 1
    elseif sceneState.action == "select" then
        local choice = options[sceneState.selectedIndex]
        if choice then
            -- The gate is enforced HERE as well as greyed in the list: the row
            -- is still selectable so the player can read why, but committing
            -- it says no and explains, rather than silently doing nothing.
            local info = api.skillCost(memberInfo.actor, choice.id)
            if info.blocked then
                api.battle.showMessage(choice.name .. ": " .. (info.reason or "Unavailable"))
            else
                api.battle.startTargetSelection({ type = "skill", id = choice.id })
            end
        end
    end
elseif sceneState.itemSelect then
    local items = api.items()
    if sceneState.action == "up" then
        if #items > 0 then sceneState.selectedIndex = (sceneState.selectedIndex - 2) % #items + 1 end
    elseif sceneState.action == "down" then
        if #items > 0 then sceneState.selectedIndex = sceneState.selectedIndex % #items + 1 end
    elseif sceneState.action == "cancel" then
        sceneState.itemSelect = false
        sceneState.selectedIndex = sceneState.submenuReturnIndex or 1
    elseif sceneState.action == "select" then
        local choice = items[sceneState.selectedIndex]
        if choice then
            api.battle.startTargetSelection({ type = "item", id = choice.id, itemIndex = sceneState.selectedIndex })
        end
    end
else
    -- Dispatch on the command's id, never on the row number: with the set
    -- authored per creature, row 3 is Defend for a Pixie and does not exist
    -- for an Egg. Wrapping counts the rows this creature actually has.
    local cmds = api.battleCommands(memberInfo.actor)
    local n = #cmds
    if sceneState.action == "left" or sceneState.action == "up" then
        if n > 0 then sceneState.selectedIndex = (sceneState.selectedIndex - 2) % n + 1 end
    elseif sceneState.action == "right" or sceneState.action == "down" then
        if n > 0 then sceneState.selectedIndex = sceneState.selectedIndex % n + 1 end
    elseif sceneState.action == "cancel" then
        api.battle.undoAction()
    elseif sceneState.action == "select" then
        local cmd = cmds[sceneState.selectedIndex]
        if cmd then
            if cmd.resolve == "target" then
                api.battle.startTargetSelection(cmd.action or { type = cmd.id })
            elseif cmd.resolve == "submenu" then
                -- Remember the row to come back to, rather than the magic 2/4
                -- the cancel branches used to hardcode.
                sceneState.submenuReturnIndex = sceneState.selectedIndex
                if cmd.submenu == "skill" then sceneState.skillSelect = true
                elseif cmd.submenu == "item" then sceneState.itemSelect = true end
                sceneState.selectedIndex = 1
            elseif cmd.resolve == "commit" then
                local act = { type = cmd.id }
                if cmd.action then
                    act = { type = cmd.action.type, id = cmd.action.id }
                    -- A committed action carries its target object. Only "self"
                    -- is resolvable without asking the player, which is exactly
                    -- what a command that skips target selection needs.
                    if cmd.action.target == "self" then act.target = memberInfo.actor end
                end
                api.battle.commitAction(memberInfo.index, act)
            end
        end
    end
end
scripts.handleLogInput:
local sceneState = ctx.sceneState
if sceneState.action == "select" then
    if api.battle.isLogRevealing() then
        api.battle.finishLogReveal()
        sceneState.hookHandled = true
    elseif api.battle.isAnimationPlaying() then
        sceneState.hookHandled = true
    elseif sceneState.eventQueueIndex <= #(sceneState.eventsQueue or {}) then
        api.battle.advanceLog()
        -- Reward and level-up narration share their matching window. The
        -- confirm that advances beyond a fully-read line starts that beat.
        if sceneState.pendingRewardLog and sceneState.eventQueueIndex > #(sceneState.eventsQueue or {}) then
            sceneState.pendingRewardLog = nil
            sceneState.combatState = "victory"
            sceneState.victoryStage = 1
        elseif sceneState.pendingLevelUpLog and sceneState.eventQueueIndex > #(sceneState.eventsQueue or {}) then
            sceneState.pendingLevelUpLog = nil
            sceneState.combatState = "levelup"
        end
        sceneState.hookHandled = true
    else
        sceneState.hookHandled = false
    end
else
    sceneState.hookHandled = false
end
scripts.handleTransition:
local sceneState = ctx.sceneState
if sceneState.action ~= "select" or not sceneState.battle then
    sceneState.hookHandled = false
    return
end

-- A reward log line and its matching window are one presentation beat. Once
-- the line is read, leave the window in place and start its drain animation;
-- no information is presented a second time.
if sceneState.combatState == "log" and sceneState.pendingRewardLog
    and sceneState.eventQueueIndex > #(sceneState.eventsQueue or {}) then
    sceneState.pendingRewardLog = nil
    sceneState.combatState = "victory"
    sceneState.victoryStage = 1
    sceneState.hookHandled = true
    return
end

-- Gold/items precede EXP. After Gold finishes draining, open the EXP window
-- at the same moment its ordinary typewriter console line begins revealing.
if sceneState.combatState == "victory" and sceneState.rewardPresentationStage == "spoils" then
    if sceneState.victoryStage == 0 then
        sceneState.victoryStage = 1
    elseif sceneState.victoryStage == 2 then
        sceneState.rewardPresentationStage = "exp"
        sceneState.victoryStage = 0
        sceneState.eventsQueue = sceneState.eventsQueue or {}
        sceneState.eventQueueIndex = #sceneState.eventsQueue + 1
        local reward = sceneState.victory or {}
        table.insert(sceneState.eventsQueue, { type = "text", text = "Earned " .. tostring(reward.exp or 0) .. " Experience Points." })
        sceneState.pendingRewardLog = "exp"
        sceneState.combatState = "log"
        api.battle.advanceLog()
    end
    sceneState.hookHandled = true
    return
end

local before = sceneState.combatState
sceneState.hookHandled = api.battle.handleTransition(sceneState.action)
if before == "log" and sceneState.combatState == "victory" and not sceneState.rewardAnnounced then
    sceneState.rewardAnnounced = true
    sceneState.rewardPresentationStage = "spoils"
    sceneState.victoryStage = 0
    sceneState.eventsQueue = sceneState.eventsQueue or {}
    sceneState.eventQueueIndex = #sceneState.eventsQueue + 1
    local reward = sceneState.victory or {}
    table.insert(sceneState.eventsQueue, { type = "text", text = "Found " .. tostring(reward.gold or 0) .. " Gold." })
    sceneState.pendingRewardLog = "spoils"
    sceneState.combatState = "log"
    api.battle.advanceLog()
    sceneState.hookHandled = true
end
scripts.refreshConsole:
local sceneState = ctx.sceneState
local memberInfo = (sceneState.livingMembers or {})[sceneState.activeMemberIdx or 1]
local monster = memberInfo and memberInfo.actor
local rows, helps = {}, {}
if sceneState.confirmPhase then
    table.insert(rows, { name = "Execute Round" })
    table.insert(rows, { name = "Back" })
    helps[1] = "Execute all queued party actions for this round."
    helps[2] = "Go back to modify queued actions."
elseif sceneState.skillSelect then
    -- A known skill is never hidden: an unusable one is shown greyed with its
    -- cost still legible and the reason in the context-help bar. A row that
    -- vanishes looks like a bug and teaches the player nothing.
    for _, skId in ipairs((monster and monster.skills) or {}) do
        local sk = api.getSkill(skId)
        if sk then
            local info = api.skillCost(monster, skId)
            table.insert(rows, { name = sk.name, icon = sk.icon or 0,
                costSegments = info.cost, disabled = info.blocked })
            table.insert(helps, info.blocked
                and ((info.reason or "Unavailable") .. " -- " .. (sk.description or ""))
                or (sk.description or ""))
        end
    end
    if #rows == 0 then table.insert(rows, { name = "(No skills)" }) end
elseif sceneState.itemSelect then
    local pending = {}
    for _, mInfo in ipairs(sceneState.livingMembers or {}) do
        local act = sceneState.pendingActions and sceneState.pendingActions[mInfo.index]
        if act and act.type == "item" and (act.id or act.itemId) then
            local itemId = act.id or act.itemId
            pending[itemId] = (pending[itemId] or 0) + 1
        end
    end
    for _, it in ipairs(api.items()) do
        local full = api.getItem(it.id)
        local queuedCount = pending[it.id] or 0
        local availQty = math.max(0, it.qty - queuedCount)
        local label = (it.name or "?") .. " x" .. tostring(availQty)
        if queuedCount > 0 then
            label = label .. " [" .. queuedCount .. " pending]"
        end
        table.insert(rows, { name = label, icon = (full and full.icon) or it.icon or 0 })
        table.insert(helps, (full and full.description) or "")
    end
    if #rows == 0 then table.insert(rows, { name = "(No items)" }) end
else
    -- The command set is this creature's, not a fixed five: engine.json
    -- `battleCommands` filtered by the actor's own list. An Egg shows one row.
    sceneState.commandIds = {}
    for i, cmd in ipairs(api.battleCommands(monster)) do
        table.insert(rows, { name = cmd.label or cmd.id })
        helps[i] = cmd.help or ""
        sceneState.commandIds[i] = cmd.id
    end
end
sceneState.commandRows = rows
sceneState.currentHelpText = helps[sceneState.selectedIndex] or ""

windows.visible: sceneState._dockContentReady ~= false and sceneState.combatState == 'input' and not sceneState.targetSelect and not sceneState.skillSelect and not sceneState.itemSelect
sceneState._dockContentReady ~= false and sceneState.combatState == 'input' and not sceneState.targetSelect and sceneState.skillSelect == true
sceneState._dockContentReady ~= false and sceneState.combatState == 'input' and not sceneState.targetSelect and sceneState.itemSelect == true
sceneState._dockContentReady ~= false and sceneState.combatState == 'input' and sceneState.targetSelect == true and not sceneState.inspectingTarget
sceneState._dockContentReady ~= false and sceneState.combatState == 'input' and sceneState.targetSelect == true and sceneState.inspectingTarget == true
windows.title: Battler Info

windows.visible: sceneState.combatState == 'log' or (sceneState.combatState == 'victory' and sceneState.rewardPresentationStage ~= nil) or sceneState.combatState == 'levelup'

dock.cursor: sceneState.combatState == 'input' and (sceneState.livingMembers and sceneState.livingMembers[sceneState.activeMemberIdx or 1] and sceneState.livingMembers[sceneState.activeMemberIdx or 1].index or 0) or 0
